purpose: Understand decision and behavior patterns using evidence; synthetic example only.

evidence.text: In a synthetic project episode, the subject reported three concurrent goals and one deadline.
The synthetic subject reported a protected work block was interrupted twice.

claims.claim: Concurrent active goals may be contributing to missed milestones.

predictions: Total estimated effort exceeds available hours.
weakening_evidence: A realistic effort inventory shows sufficient capacity.
mechanisms.discriminating_test: Compare estimated required effort to available capacity for one week.

predictions: Milestone throughput improves when work-in-progress is limited.
weakening_evidence: Low switching and no improvement under a work-in-progress limit.
mechanisms.discriminating_test: Limit active tasks for one week and compare throughput.
